BiblicalUsage: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe some foolishness will not be pounded out, because the heart has to change, not just the habits.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
